title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Leonard Williams (Achilles) off injury report Monday
items.desc: Leonard Williams is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: Williams was added to the injury report earlier this week. He'll be good to go in his usual role on Seattle's defensive line.

items.author: Ari Koslow

items.title: Jack Sanborn (concussion) off injury report Monday

items.title: Malik Muhammad II (toe) listed questionable Monday

items.title: Kenny Gainwell (hip) expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Kenny Gainwell is expected to play in Sunday's game against the Falcons.
items.impact: The Buccaneers did not have any elevations from their practice squad. Gainwell remains listed as questionable, but he will likely be available for Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jadarian Price (chest) off injury report Monday
items.desc: Jadarian Price is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: Price will make his return from injured reserve. Zach Charbonnet is also off the injury report, making it the first week all season the Seahawks backfield will be healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) off injury report Monday
items.desc: Zach Charbonnet is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: Charbonnet will be ready to make his season debut. He'll be a touchdown dependent flex play in his first game back for fantasy managers.

items.impact: Mitchell will add depth in the backfield for Philadelphia. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

items.title: RJ Harvey (knee) placed on short-term IR
items.desc: RJ Harvey (knee) was placed on IR with a designation to return.
items.impact: Harvey sustained a knee injury at practice earlier this week. He will now be forced to miss at least the next four games. JK Dobbins and Jonah Coleman could see more touches as a result.
